src/Cluckwork.Api/Configuration/FarmBann.name: Banner size setting
src/Cluckwork.Api/Configuration/FarmBann.description: Sets the largest banner image allowed and stops the server starting if the value is invalid.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Configuration/FarmLogo.name: Logo size setting
src/Cluckwork.Api/Configuration/FarmLogo.description: Sets the largest logo image allowed and stops the server starting if the value is invalid.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Configuration/OtlpOpti.name: Monitoring export settings
src/Cluckwork.Api/Configuration/OtlpOpti.description: Holds where and how the server sends its monitoring data, if turned on.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Configuration/OwnerGra.name: Owner grace period setting
src/Cluckwork.Api/Configuration/OwnerGra.description: Sets how many days an Owner may go without two-step verification.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Configuration/SharedSt.name: Shared storage settings
src/Cluckwork.Api/Configuration/SharedSt.description: Holds the connection settings for the Redis store used to share state between servers.

src/Cluckwork.Api/HealthChecks/DatabaseR.name: Database ready check
src/Cluckwork.Api/HealthChecks/DatabaseR.description: Reports ready only when the database can be reached and its structure is up to date.

src/Cluckwork.Api/HealthChecks/DurableJo.name: Background job check
src/Cluckwork.Api/HealthChecks/DurableJo.description: Warns when the background job runner has silently stalled.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/BindingFailure.name: Bad request reply
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/BindingFailure.description: Replies with a clear message when a request is malformed and cannot be read.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkEdgeS.name: Front-door security setup
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkEdgeS.description: Decides which proxies are trusted to pass on the visitor's real address and protocol.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkHealt.name: Health check setup
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkHealt.description: Registers the checks that say whether the server is alive and ready.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkIdent.name: Sign-in setup
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkIdent.description: Sets up sign-in, tokens, roles and the rules for who may do what.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkPersi.name: Database setup
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkPersi.description: Connects the server to its Postgres database.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkRateL.name: Request limit setup
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkRateL.description: Sets the caps on how often sign-in, app and general requests may be made.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkShare.name: Shared storage setup
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkShare.description: Connects the shared Redis store and checks its connection setting before serving.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkTelem.name: Monitoring setup
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkTelem.description: Turns on the server's metrics and traces and exports them when configured.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/DefaultRespons.name: Default no-cache rule
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/DefaultRespons.description: Tells browsers and proxies not to store responses unless a page says it is safe.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/FarmBannerRequ.name: Banner upload size cap
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/FarmBannerRequ.description: Rejects banner uploads over the size limit before they are fully received.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/FarmLogoReques.name: Logo upload size cap
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/FarmLogoReques.description: Rejects logo uploads over the size limit before they are fully received.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/OtlpConfigurat.name: Monitoring settings resolver
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/OtlpConfigurat.description: Works out the final monitoring export settings from the configuration.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/PlaintextDataP.name: Unencrypted key guard
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/PlaintextDataP.description: Refuses to run if stored encryption keys are unencrypted, as a database backup could then forge sign-in data.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/ProcessRole.cs.name: Run mode
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/ProcessRole.cs.description: Decides once at start whether this run is the web server or a one-off command.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/RequestBodyLim.name: Request size limit
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/RequestBodyLim.description: Rejects requests whose body is bigger than the allowed size.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/ServingBootGua.name: Production safety checks
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/ServingBootGua.description: Checks the live server's security settings at start and refuses to run if unsafe.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/SpaShell.cs.name: Web app page host
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/SpaShell.cs.description: Serves the web app's main page with matching security headers.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/StaticAssetCac.name: Web file caching
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/StaticAssetCac.description: Sets how long browsers keep the web app's files.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Logging/ExceptionRedac.name: Error text scrubber
src/Cluckwork.Api/Logging/ExceptionRedac.description: Hides secrets found in error text before logs are written.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Logging/RedactingLogge.name: Safe logging pipeline
src/Cluckwork.Api/Logging/RedactingLogge.description: Builds the log setup so every log passes through the scrubber first.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Logging/SensitiveDataR.name: Log secret remover
src/Cluckwork.Api/Logging/SensitiveDataR.description: Removes passwords, tokens, cookies, connection strings and emails from log lines.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Program.cs.name: Server start-up
src/Cluckwork.Api/Program.cs.description: Starts the server: picks a mode, sets up services, adds checks in order and serves the app or runs a command.
